description: "A same-stream TP2 NCCL all-reduce preserves every measured BF16 result but costs 5.68 to 23.05 ms for 96 reductions, so this transport is retained as a correctness reference rather than an integration candidate."
date: 2026-09-07

---

**Question.** Can one captured NCCL graph perform all 96 TP2 PairReduce
operations for verifier row counts 32 through 128 without a host payload path
and fit the more-than-451 tok/s regime?

| setup | |
| --- | --- |
| nodes | gx10-5e36 (rank 0), gx10-2a13 (rank 1), GB10, sm_121 |
| kernel | 6.17.13-rocket64k, 64 KiB pages |
| fabric | 2 RoCE rails, GID 3, NCCL `NET/IB` |
| implementation | `c2352d87cfbdf0a4511936158000c4327ebff0cf` |
| baseline | `e1f584f`, GPU to mapped-host staging with two stream fences per reduction |
| container | `vllm/vllm-openai:qwen38-flash-next`, vLLM `8e685d198` |
| NCCL header and loaded runtime | 2.30.7 / 2.30.7 |
| PyTorch compile contract | NCCL 2.29.7 |

The vLLM and SGLang collective paths were inspected before this cutover. Both
enqueue NCCL on the caller stream during graph capture and keep communicator
abort and teardown outside capture. SGLang was inspected at `c99d906effa8bd05573995127f0d4a0984c5a96a`.

```bash
cmake --build engines/qwen38-flash-next-nvfp4-2b/build -j 8
ctest --test-dir engines/qwen38-flash-next-nvfp4-2b/build --output-on-failure

# Run concurrently on both nodes. Rank 1 adds --host 192.168.100.10 --rank 1.
NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=enp1s0f1np1 \
NCCL_IB_HCA=rocep1s0f1,roceP2p1s0f1 NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 \
engines/qwen38-flash-next-nvfp4-2b/build/qwen38-pair-reduce-bench \
  --rank 0 --warmup 100 --iterations 1000
```

```
100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 8
qwen38 PairReduce: 24 verifier shapes, graph replay, and terminal fault passed
```

One graph contains 96 `ncclAllReduce` calls followed by BF16-to-FP32
conversions. The graph replays on one non-default transaction stream. One event
is the post-transaction completion and health fence. Construction allocates one
fixed 128x2560 BF16 scratch tensor and one event; replay allocates nothing and
copies no payload through host memory.

| rows | policy point | rank 0 median / p95 | rank 1 median / p95 | slowest median per reduction | output FNV-1a | max abs error |
| ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | ---: |
| 32 | K1, sequences 16 | 5.676 / 6.137 ms | 5.677 / 6.141 ms | 59.13 us | `eea038f30aaa9968` | 0 |
| 64 | K3, sequences 16 | 8.636 / 9.209 ms | 8.641 / 9.219 ms | 90.01 us | `dcec235ae56cf902` | 0 |
| 80 | K4, sequences 16 | 11.218 / 11.883 ms | 11.214 / 11.878 ms | 116.86 us | `b5a93adf4e00e56c` | 0 |
| 128 | K7, sequences 16 | 23.051 / 23.511 ms | 23.050 / 23.512 ms | 240.12 us | `bc2ab909ad3552db` | 0 |

The hashes equal the earlier mapped-host implementation for all four row
counts. Its 96-call median upper bounds were 2.72, 3.72, 4.24, and 5.74 ms for
rows 32, 64, 80, and 128. That path is excluded from production because every
reduction performs GPU-to-mapped-host staging and two stream synchronizations.

```bash
# Both ranks capture first. Rank 1 then stalls for 500 ms.
qwen38-pair-reduce-bench --rank 0 --port 18953 --timeout-ms 100 \
  --warmup 1 --iterations 1
qwen38-pair-reduce-bench --rank 1 --host 192.168.100.10 --port 18953 \
  --timeout-ms 100 --fault-stall-rank 1 --fault-stall-ms 500 \
  --warmup 1 --iterations 1
```

```
rank0_status=1 rank1_status=2
qwen38-pair-reduce-bench: qwen38 PairReduce completion timed out after 100000223 ns
```

Both rank containers were absent after the fault run. A fault makes the
PairReduce object terminal. Communicator abort runs outside the graph, and the
decoder cannot publish the transaction after completion failure. Metric labels
are bounded by rank, 24 row buckets plus invalid, dtype, and four outcomes.
Trace and request IDs remain span fields.

**Verdict.** Rejected on value. K1 at concurrency 16 spends 6.14 ms p95 on
PairReduce alone, K4 spends 11.88 ms, and K7 spends 23.51 ms. The 451 tok/s
aggregate regime allows about 2.22 ms per accepted token before accounting for
attention, MoE, state, logits, or sampling. The device-only graph remains an
authenticated correctness and fault reference; it is not accepted for decoder
integration.

**Next.**

- fuse or specialize the fabric path below NCCL's 96-call launch and protocol cost
- profile the register-resident GDN verifier with accepted-prefix replay
- keep graph cold construction and exact output hashes in every replacement gate

**Reopen if.**

- an NCCL runtime, network plugin, driver, or firmware release changes captured
  small-collective latency on this two-node GB10 pair
